Name: JumJum Jr. - Content Pack
Author: Branic
Description:
REQUIRES: ContentPatcher v1.4+, SMAPI v2.6+

This is a content pack conversion of the 'JumJum Jr.' xnb mod by ProJared. It utilizes the ContentPatcher mod by Pathoschild.

Original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/197]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/197[/url]﻿

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=3][b]ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION BY ProJared:[/b]
[/size]
[quote]Straight from the old lands of Haven & Hearth, JumJum Jr. can now protect YOUR farm!

JumJum Jr. replaces Rarecrow #8 (the tiki head one). You receive that after donating 40 items to the museum.

Enjoy﻿![/quote]
